Maybe they mis-specified units. Or maybe they think adding 30 gallons yields 40 gallons because starting was 10 gallons? Actually starting might be 10 gallons already? The car has 10 liters currently. Convert to gallons: 1 gallon ~ 3.78541 liters. So 10 liters = 2.64 gallons approx. If they want to end at 40 gallons, they'd need to add 37.36 gallons (~141.9 liters). However they ask to add 30 gallons. That would bring them to around 32.64 gallons, not 40. There's inconsistency. Maybe they mis-specified units. Or maybe they think adding 30 gallons yields 40 gallons because starting was 10 gallons? Actually starting might be 10 gallons already? But earlier data shows 10 liters. Could be confusion.

Better approach: Ask clarification. According to policy, we cannot proceed without clarity. Also we can't call fillFuelTank directly unless we confirm correct quantity.
